student_judgment: Yes—run the LLM scan as a secondary check because regex can miss PII hidden behind abbreviations, aliases, or nonstandard schemas, creating significant compliance and privacy risk. The extra compute cost is usually far lower than the potential impact of exposing restricted data, so a layered detection approach provides a better cost-to-risk balance.
